args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera gel
- Rash guard or UV protective swim shirt

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight, long-sleeve shirt (for sun protection)
- Small backpack for day hikes
- Water bottle or hydration pack
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts for men)
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt or aloha attire (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping day: Reusable shopping bags

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Medications
- Contact lenses and solution (if applicable)
- Makeup (if desired)
- Razor

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for beach relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Earplugs and eye mask
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Ziplock bags (for wet items, electronics protection)
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

REMEMBER:
- Pack light - many items can be purchased in Hawaii if forgotten
- Leave room in luggage for souvenirs
- Check airline baggage restrictions before packing
